intro: The department imparts knowledge through three programmes — a Bachelor's programme with a total intake of 60 students per academic year, a Master of Technology, and a Doctoral (Ph.D.) programme — to build technical and research excellence in specialised avenues of Electrical Engineering.
body: The undergraduate program delivers wide knowledge of Electrical Engineering in four broad areas: communication technology, control technology, electronics, and power & energy. To broaden the students' knowledge, the department offers elective courses designed for interested students.

In addition to the undergraduate program, the department plays a vital role in bringing forth world-class postgraduates and researchers. The Masters program provides students with strong knowledge in three areas of Electrical Engineering: Signal Processing and Communication, Power Engineering, and VLSI.

Around 120 research scholars work on challenging problems in different areas of Electrical Engineering. The department continually upgrades its experimental and computational facilities for research & development and consultancy activities, so as to produce state-of-the-art research output.
